summary: Older adult referred after hospital discharge for self-care and bill management concerns.
planted_issues: Missing element: no prior services documented. QA should report it as an information gap.

expected_facts.statement: Referred by a home health nurse on 2026-10-15.
Little food in the home, a final utility notice, and missed medication doses.
Wants to stay in his own home and get help with bills.
Lives alone in a home he owns, with stairs to the bedroom.
Hospitalized 2026-10-02 to 10-08 for a heart condition; five medications; trouble tracking doses.
Reports no alcohol or other substance use.
Son calls weekly; neighbor checks on him most days.
Independent, walks daily, open to help with organization.
